name: nimbus-ui-studio-lab
description: Enterprise React design system and interactive lab for agentic AI applications.

scripts.test: node --test tools/governance/governance.test.mjs tools/governance/contributor-metadata.test.mjs tools/workspace/workspace.test.mjs tools/workspace/typescript-config.test.mjs tools/workspace/reference-apps.test.mjs tools/workspace/sites-config.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tools/studio/*.test.ts tools/local/*.test.ts && turbo run test
scripts.studio: npm run studio:sync-runtime && npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@12.3.4 --call "pnpm --filter @nimbus-ui-studio/reference-vite dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
scripts.check: pnpm studio:sync-runtime && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
